import.title: Import catalog
import.subtitle: Upload an Excel workbook with subjects, teachers and groups. You will see a preview first, and nothing is saved until you confirm.

contract.title: Workbook structure
contract.intro: The workbook must have these three sheets with these columns. Sheet and column names must match the template.
contract.legend: Columns marked as optional may be left empty. The order of the columns does not matter; their names do.

rules.noId: No Id column is accepted: sheets refer to each other by code, email or name.
rules.carreraExists: The Carrera of each subject must already exist in the system; the import does not create careers.
rules.horasPositive: HorasTotales must be a whole number greater than zero.
rules.periodoFormat: Periodo must use the format YYYY-S1 or YYYY-S2, for example 2026-S1.
rules.correoDocenteResolves: CorreoDocente, on the Grupos sheet, must match an active teacher on the Docentes sheet or one already in the system; the import does not reactivate teachers.
rules.diasTokens: Dias, on the Grupos sheet, takes the Spanish day names (Lunes, Martes, Miércoles, Jueves, Viernes, Sábado, Domingo) or their three-letter abbreviations (Lun, Mar, Mié, Jue, Vie, Sáb, Dom), separated by commas. Case and accents are ignored.
rules.diasEffect: Dias: if you leave the column out, the stored days of every group are kept. A cell with days replaces the stored days; an empty cell leaves them as they are. The import never removes days.

controller.title: Data controller
controller.body: Universidad Americana (UAM) is the controller of the data collected in this system.
controller.contact: [UAM address and contact office: to be defined]

purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.body: The data is used only to process your justification request and its corrections. It is not used for any other purpose.

recipients.title: Recipients
recipients.body: The request data and the documents you attach are sent by institutional email to the teachers of the subjects your request names. If the request is escalated, the coordination of your career receives a minimal notification by email and consults the request and its documents inside the system.

data.title: Data we process
data.identity: Identity and academic data from your account.
data.request: Request data: cause, dates and subjects.
data.health: Health data, which is sensitive data and may appear in those documents.

mandatory.title: Required data
mandatory.body: To submit a request, the data and documents each step asks for and your consent are required. Without them the request cannot be processed.

rights.title: Your rights and withdrawing consent
rights.body: You may exercise your rights of access, rectification, cancellation and opposition, and withdraw your consent, in writing addressed to the faculty secretary's office. Withdrawal has no retroactive effect.

retention.title: Retention period
retention.body: The data is kept for five years and then cancelled.
